subject: Post-contract: Integrate.ai custody & implementation sprint roster
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Novak <sam.novak@integrate.ai>, Dana Lee <dana.lee@integrate.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-contract: Integrate.ai custody & implementation sprint roster

Hi Marissa / Tessa —

We closed Integrate.ai last night (signed SOW attached). Quick context so CS & Implementation can pick up without a gap:

- Deal: Integrate.ai (SaaS + custom connector). Annual commit, start-of-billing aligned to first production token on 2028-06-01. Deal ID: DEAL-7842-INTAI.
- Primary contacts: Sam Novak (Product lead), Dana Lee (Platform/Infra). Procurement contact: procurement@integrate.ai (will route PO).
- Key asks / constraints from the buyer:
  * Private VPC deployment in us-west-2 with customer-managed KMS (HSM integration required)
  * SOC 2 evidence required before production cutover (they want pen-test summary + audit log samples)
  * A 6-week phased rollout: staging -> limited beta -> prod; target prod by 2028-06-01
  * Prefix caching required for their 2 largest flows; expect spike of ~6000 qps at day-1 peak for embeddings pipeline.

Attachments in the signing email: IntegrateAI_SOW_v1.pdf (final), MVP_rollout_timeline.xlsx (proposed sprint plan), integrateai_network_topology.png (their infra). I also pushed the DocuSign summary to the related links.

Immediate asks for CS/Impl:
1) Marissa: own the CS relationship and be the primary post-sale point. Lead success plan and SLA discussion.
2) Tessa: lead the implementation sprint plan and owner for delivery tasks (infra, staging access, test corpus ingestion)
3) We need an internal kickoff (30–45m) with Integrate.ai to align scope and confirm who from their side will do infra/network changes. Proposed windows: Wed 4/12 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 4/13 09:00–10:00 PT.

Open risks I flagged in the deal: procurement timeline (PO expected week of 4/16), HSM integration unknowns (likely needs our Private package engineers), and quota gating that may require temporary burst capacity on Dedicated.

Marissa/Tessa — please confirm owners and whether you want me to intro additional Redwood engineering (private deployments lead) and security for the SOC 2 ask.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: IntegrateAI_SOW_v1.pdf, MVP_rollout_timeline.xlsx, integrateai_network_topology.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Novak <sam.novak@integrate.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-contract: Integrate.ai custody & implementation sprint roster

Thanks Ben — congrats on the close. Happy to take point as CS. A few questions before I schedule the kickoff:

1) Can you confirm expected API / token quotas for the beta and prod phases (we'll need numbers to size rate-limiting and cost estimates for the customer).
2) For staging access: do we have a dataset snapshot from Integrate.ai or will they provide a synthetic corpus? If they plan to share PII, we need to loop in Security immediately.
3) Procurement contact — do we need the PO before we start staging work or only before production?

Assuming ownership, I will:
- Draft a 30-day success play with onboarding milestones
- Set up the kickoff with the customer once Tessa confirms implementation availability
- Ask Customer Insights to pull usage benchmarks from similar accounts for sizing guidance

Sam — looping you to confirm who from Integrate.ai should be on the kickoff (network/infra + product).

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Sam Novak <sam.novak@integrate.ai>, procurement@integrate.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-contract: Integrate.ai custody & implementation sprint roster

Marissa — quick answers inline:

1) Quotas: For beta (limited users) we'll start with 200 qps sustained and a 1,000 qps burst; prod day-1 peak expected ~6,000 qps for embeddings. I'll add a note to the HubSpot deal that we recommended temporary burst on Dedicated for week-of-prod.
2) Staging dataset: Sam confirmed they'll provide a sanitized snapshot for staging (expected ~20GB). If any PII remains, Security needs to review.
3) Procurement: Integrate.ai prefers to issue the PO before prod cutover; staging can proceed on the signed SOW at their risk. Procurement contact is procurement@integrate.ai — I've cc'd them here.

Additional notes: I uploaded the signed SOW to the drive link and created the HubSpot handoff task: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/DEAL-7842. DocuSign envelope is complete; link above.

Sam / Dana — if you can confirm who will do network changes (routing to our VPC peering / firewall rules) that will help Tessa plan the earliest staging date.

Ben

Attachments: none (see earlier attachments)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-contract: Integrate.ai custody & implementation sprint roster

Thanks Ben — and thanks Marissa for stepping in as CS.

I accept the implementation lead role. Below is an initial owner roster and immediate next steps; I put target dates based on the attached MVP_rollout_timeline.xlsx.

Owners & immediate actions:
- Implementation lead (overall): Tessa Morgan — runbook, sprint cadence, daily stand during the 6-week rollout
- Infra & networking: Integrate.ai (Dana Lee) + Redwood Private deployments engineer (I will loop Aaron Kim from Private PD) — Tgt: staging VPC peering by 2028-04-20
- Security evidence & SOC 2 artifacts: Marissa to coordinate with Security (I will create the security checklist and request samples) — Tgt: initial packet to Integrate.ai by 2028-04-18
- Data ingestion & test corpus: Integrate.ai to deliver sanitized snapshot by 2028-04-17
- Acceptance criteria: defined in the attached timeline (functional smoke tests + infra sign-off)

Proposed kickoff: Thu, 2028-04-12 10:00 AM PT (30 min). Ben — please send the calendar invite with the external attendees and include the drive links.

I'll schedule an internal pre-kick for Redwood folks only (15m) on 4/12 at 9:30 AM PT to align owners and prepare the runbook. Marissa — I'll need your success play draft before that pre-kick if possible.

Risks to escalate now: HSM integration timeline (possible blocker), procurement PO delays, and any unexpected compliance exclusions for the sanitized snapshot.

Tessa Morgan
Implementation Lead, Customer Delivery
Redwood Inference
